question: Should OpenClaw accept this new Telegram group/topic UI config surface together with the cron no-delivery wake behavior, or should the cron behavior be split before this proceeds?
rationale: The branch adds new user-facing config keys and changes cron wake/message-delivery semantics, so the mechanical metadata fix does not settle whether the combined product/API surface belongs in one PR.

options.title: Split cron before merge
options.body: Keep the Telegram scoped UI config work focused and move cron no-delivery wake suppression into a separate PR with its own proof.

options.title: Accept combined after refresh
options.body: Allow both behaviors in one PR after the branch is rebased, generated metadata is refreshed, and real proof covers both surfaces.

options.title: Decline the config surface
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if per-group/topic UI overrides are not desired in core Telegram config right now.

recommendation.title: Split cron before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the Telegram scoped UI config work focused and move cron no-delivery wake suppression into a separate PR with its own proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans config surface policy, generated metadata architecture, and cross-surface product scope, where steipete has both repository-lead and recent metadata-architecture history.
